topic: Tooth enamel: cannot regrow, 96% mineral, critical pH 5.5, saliva remineralization
caption:
Skin heals. Bones knit back together. Even your liver regrows. But tooth enamel never grows back, because the cells that make it are gone by the time your tooth appears.

It is about 96% mineral, harder than bone, yet acid below pH 5.5 slowly dissolves it. Saliva and fluoride can repair early weak spots, but not a real cavity. Save this for the next time you sip soda all afternoon. Sources: NIDCR and the American Dental Association.

Follow for one surprising body fact every day. Did you know enamel couldn't heal itself?
